propositions: The tolerant_parse function returns the first parseable JSON object in a model reply, allowing quoted tool results or examples to masquerade as the real payload.
Schema-blind extraction has recurred five times across different model deployments and provider changes (Bedrock cutover), indicating a systematic class of defect rather than isolated bugs.
The prompted structured-output path must be hardened with schema-filtered candidate selection and explicit sentinel output channels to prevent decoy JSON from defeating extraction.
Provider-native structured output (Bedrock outputConfig) should replace prompted output only where live measurement confirms safety per model, not via blanket assumptions.
A reusable provider-matrix raw-output baseline and evaluation harness is required to measure before/after extraction quality and prevent regression on future model swaps.
